description: Stereo compressor after the LA-2A, with a switchable ratio, makeup gain and a parallel blend

params.text: Lowers the level at which compression starts, from 1V with the knob down to 0V with it up, measured against an envelope follower on the two inputs averaged; the panel prints Amount
Picks the ratio used above that level, 3:1 as a compressor or 10:1 as a limiter
Makeup gain applied to the compressed signal, 0dB to 40dB, which is a multiplier of 1 to 100
Passes both inputs straight to the outputs and puts the lamp out
Blends the untouched input against the compressed and made-up signal, for parallel compression

inputs.text: Left audio in, and the signal used for both channels when the right jack is empty

outputs.text: The left channel compressed, made up and blended, clamped to ±10V
The right channel compressed, made up and blended, clamped to ±10V

notes: the lamp lights while either output reaches 9.9V, which is where the clamp starts.
the detector follows both inputs averaged, so the channels are always reduced together; the attack is 10ms and the release 60ms, or 1.5 seconds once the envelope falls below 0.1.

inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only
